name: Santosh Bakya

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: The poems published here under Santosh Bakya’s name place compassion beside the imagination’s power to renew an exhausted world. Their lively scenes turn moral questions into encounters with music, painting, trees and animals.

“The Benevolence of the Magician” moves from a troubling dirge to a transformed landscape, where a piece of blue sky seems to become a squirrel. In “The Ego Maniac and the Empath”, an artist carries on painting and singing despite a contemptuous onlooker, then offers kindness to an injured dog. Both poems find an answer to callousness in attentive, playful acts of care.
